lines.text: On a Sabbath in a synagogue, Jesus teaches, and a woman there has been disabled by a spirit eighteen years.
Jesus calls the woman over, places His hands on her, and she immediately straightens up and glorifies God.
The synagogue leader, indignant that Jesus healed on the Sabbath, tells the crowd there are seven days for work.
Jesus says each unties his ox or donkey on the Sabbath, and Satan has kept this daughter of Isaac bound.
All His adversaries are humiliated, and the whole crowd rejoices at all the glorious things He was doing.
